samples.label: atrial_flutter

samples.label: tachycardia
samples.name: Sinus tachycardia
samples.signature: Rate > 100 bpm, regular RR, narrow QRS, P waves preserved.

samples.label: bradycardia
samples.name: Sinus bradycardia
samples.signature: Rate < 60 bpm, regular RR, narrow QRS, P waves preserved.

samples.label: svt
samples.name: Supraventricular tachycardia
samples.signature: Very fast regular rate, short/narrow QRS, P waves absent, distorted T.

samples.label: afib
samples.name: Atrial fibrillation
samples.signature: No P waves, fibrillatory baseline, irregularly irregular RR.

samples.label: vfib
samples.name: Ventricular fibrillation
samples.signature: No identifiable QRS, chaotic undulating baseline, no organised rate.

samples.label: vpb
samples.name: Ventricular premature beat
samples.signature: Wide premature QRS, absent P, discordant T, compensatory pause.
